name: jpdfium-vips-deps
description: Permissive-only vcpkg dependencies for the GPL-free Windows libvips prebuild. libheif's default feature is the GPL-2 x265 encoder, so its defaults are disabled and only permissive codecs are selected (aom for AVIF, jpeg, openjpeg); HEIC decode comes from the port's unconditional libde265 dependency.
